cards.ex: The company's fortunes have an ebb and flow, depending on the season.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyaning omadi mavsumga qarab o'zgarib turadi.
cards.uzDef: Bir narsaning kuchayishi va susayishi, o'zgarib turishi.

cards.ex: That scandal was another nail in the coffin for his political career.
cards.exUz: Bu janjal uning siyosiy faoliyatiga yana bir zarba bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning oxiriga yaqinlashishini tezlashtiradigan omil.

cards.ex: After years of planning, their dream of opening a restaurant finally came to fruition.
cards.exUz: Ko'p yillik rejalashtirishdan so'ng, ularning restoran ochish orzusi nihoyat amalga oshdi.
cards.uzDef: Reja yoki orzuning haqiqatga aylanishi, ro'yobga chiqishi.

cards.ex: There's no historical precedent for a crisis of this magnitude.
cards.exUz: Bunday katta miqyosdagi inqiroz uchun tarixiy misol yo'q.
cards.uzDef: O'tmishda bo'lgan shunga o'xshash vaziyat yoki hodisa.

cards.ex: These protests are a signpost of growing dissatisfaction with the government.
cards.exUz: Bu noroziliklar hukumatdan tobora ko'proq norozilikning belgisi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning kelajakda sodir bo'lishi mumkinligini ko'rsatuvchi narsa.

cards.ex: The fad for those toys will run its course eventually.
cards.exUz: Bu o'yinchoqlarga bo'lgan qiziqish oxir-oqibat o'z yo'lidan boradi.
cards.uzDef: Bir narsaning oxiriga yetishi, to'liq tugashi.

cards.ex: He submitted his application at the eleventh hour.
cards.exUz: U arizasini oxirgi lahzada topshirdi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa uchun eng oxirgi imkoniyat yoki muddat.

cards.ex: His anxiety seems to stem from his childhood experiences.
cards.exUz: Uning xavotirlari bolalikdagi tajribalaridan kelib chiqqanga o'xshaydi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning boshlanish sababi yoki manbai.

cards.ex: She feels like she's at a crossroads in her career.
cards.exUz: U o'z faoliyatida chorrahada turganini his qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Muhim qaror qabul qilish kerak bo'lgan vaziyat.

cards.ex: The invention of the microchip was an inflection point in the history of technology.
cards.exUz: Mikrochipning ixtiro qilinishi texnologiya tarixida burilish nuqtasi bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatning keskin o'zgaradigan muhim nuqtasi.

cards.ex: We need to shift gears and try a different strategy.
cards.exUz: Biz tezlikni o'zgartirib, boshqa strategiyani sinab ko'rishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Yangi yo'nalishga o'tish, yondashuvni o'zgartirish.

cards.ex: The early frost was a harbinger of a harsh winter.
cards.exUz: Erta qor qattiq qishning darakchisi edi.
cards.uzDef: Kelajakda sodir bo'ladigan narsadan ogohlantiruvchi narsa.

cards.ex: After travelling the world, he came full circle and returned to his hometown.
cards.exUz: Dunyo bo'ylab sayohat qilgandan so'ng, u to'liq aylanib, o'z shahriga qaytdi.
cards.uzDef: Bir narsaning boshlangan joyiga qaytishi.

cards.ex: The campaign is really gaining momentum now.
cards.exUz: Kampaniya hozir haqiqatan ham kuchaymoqda.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa tezlashishi va kuchayishi.

cards.ex: The economy seems to be out of sync with the rest of the world.
cards.exUz: Iqtisodiyot dunyoning qolgan qismi bilan mos kelmayotganga o'xshaydi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa boshqa narsa bilan bir vaqtda yoki bir xilda harakat qilmasligi.

cards.ex: The company's poor performance last quarter was just a blip on the radar.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyaning o'tgan chorakdagi yomon ko'rsatkichlari shunchaki radardagi nuqta edi.
cards.uzDef: Qisqa muddatli va ahamiyatsiz voqea.

cards.ex: The rainbow was a fleeting moment of beauty after the storm.
cards.exUz: Kamalak bo'ron dan keyin qisqa vaqt ichida go'zallik lahzasi edi.
cards.uzDef: Tez o'tib ketadigan qisqa vaqt.

cards.ex: The enthusiasm for the project eventually petered out.
cards.exUz: Loyihaga bo'lgan qiziqish oxir-oqibat susayib ketdi.
cards.uzDef: Sekin-asta yo'qolib ketmoq, kamaymoq.

cards.ex: The internet has brought about a paradigm shift in how we communicate.
cards.exUz: Internet bizning qanday muloqot qilishimizda paradigma o'zgarishiga olib keldi.
cards.uzDef: O'ylash yoki qilish uslubining tubdan o'zgarishi.

cards.ex: A new strategy helped them turn the tide in the war.
cards.exUz: Yangi strategiya ularga urushda vaziyatni o'zgartirishga yordam berdi.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatning yo'nalishini o'zgartirish, g'alabaga erishish.

cards.ex: Electric vehicles are really gaining ground as people become more environmentally conscious.
cards.exUz: Elektr transport vositalari haqiqatan ham ustunlik qozonmoqda, chunki odamlar atrof-muhitga ko'proq e'tibor berishmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Bir sohada yoki fikrda ustunlikka erishish, yaxshilanish.

cards.ex: The company's poor sales figures were a wake-up call to management.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyaning yomon sotuv ko'rsatkichlari rahbariyat uchun ogohlantiruvchi qo'ng'iroq bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Kutilmagan, lekin muhim voqea, muammoga diqqatni qaratuvchi.

cards.ex: In retrospect, I should have invested in that company when I had the chance.
cards.exUz: Kechagi kunga nazar tashlasam, imkoniyatim bo'lganida o'sha kompaniyaga sarmoya kiritishim kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: O'tmishga qarab, keyin bilib aytish, o'tmishni baholash.

cards.ex: The increasing use of renewable energy is a long-term trend.
cards.exUz: Qayta tiklanadigan energiya manbalaridan foydalanishning ortishi - uzoq muddatli tendentsiya.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq vaqt davomida kuzatiladigan o'zgarish yoki yo'nalish.

cards.ex: The initial investment led to a snowball effect, and the company grew rapidly.
cards.exUz: Dastlabki sarmoya qor uyumi effektiga olib keldi va kompaniya tez sur'atlar bilan o'sdi.
cards.uzDef: Kichik hodisa katta oqibatlarga olib kelishi.

cards.ex: At this juncture, it's difficult to predict the future of the industry.
cards.exUz: Shu nuqtada, sanoatning kelajagini bashorat qilish qiyin.
cards.uzDef: Ayni paytda, hozirgi holatda.

cards.ex: After years of working in the city, moving to the countryside was a welcome change of pace.
cards.exUz: Shaharda yillab ishlagandan so'ng, qishloqqa ko'chib o'tish - bu xush kelibsiz tempni o'zgartirish edi.
cards.uzDef: Kundalik ishdan farqli yangi faoliyat.

cards.ex: Seeing that old photo album was a real blast from the past.
cards.exUz: O'sha eski foto albomini ko'rish o'tmishdan haqiqiy salom edi.
cards.uzDef: O'tmishni eslatuvchi narsa yoki voqea.

cards.ex: Technology is improving by leaps and bounds these days.
cards.exUz: Texnologiya hozirgi kunda juda tez rivojlanmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Juda tez rivojlanish yoki o'zgarishni anglatadi.

cards.ex: The election marked a new dawn for the country.
cards.exUz: Saylov mamlakat uchun yangi tongni anglatadi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi boshlanish yoki umid paydo bo'lishi.
